faq.a: Each article, image or page generation consumes credits from your balance. Usage is visible under Billing and My Activity.

faq.q: Do I need a credit card to start?
faq.a: No. The free plan lets you try the platform without entering payment details.

faq.q: How do I connect my Blogger blog?
faq.a: Open Blogger in the sidebar and authorize access with your Google account. Automatic publishing becomes available right after.

faq.q: Why does SEO Performance show 'no data available'?
faq.a: That happens when the property is not verified in Google Search Console yet, or when there is not enough data. The SEO Help Center explains each case.
Pix in Brazilian reais (SyncPay) and international cards in US dollars (Stripe).

faq.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
faq.a: Go to Subscription and cancel anytime. Access remains until the end of the paid period.
Yes. You retain ownership of all generated content, as stated in the Terms of Use.

faq.q: How do I delete my account and data?
faq.a: Go to My Profile → Security → Delete my account. Deletion removes your personal data and content from the platform.
